source_gaps: Android Select to Speak steps and the ChromeVox steps are paraphrased from fetched text; only the excerpts are exact. The Chromebook Select-to-speak procedure is not used by any candidate and is not carded.

source_refs.title: Use Select to Speak - Android Accessibility Help
source_refs.applicability: Android; works only on text that can be read, such as text on a web page
source_refs.verified_excerpt: This feature only works on text that can be read, like text from a web page.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Select the text you want read. In the pop-up menu, tap **More**, then tap **Read aloud**. This feature only works on text that can be read, like text from a web page.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; steps paraphrased from the named section; excerpt quoted exactly

source_refs.title: Use Select to Speak - Android Accessibility Help
source_refs.section: Step 1: Turn on Select to Speak
source_refs.applicability: Android; if Select to Speak does not appear, the page says to update Android Accessibility Suite
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Optional: To change your shortcut, tap Select to Speak shortcut.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Open **Settings**, tap **Accessibility**, tap **Select to Speak**, and turn on **Select to Speak shortcut**. If you don't see Select to Speak, update Android Accessibility Suite from Google Play, then repeat these steps.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; steps paraphrased from the named section; excerpt quoted exactly from the same section

source_refs.title: Use Select to Speak - Android Accessibility Help
source_refs.applicability: Android; a 3-finger swipe is used instead when TalkBack is on
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To start Select to Speak, use your Select to Speak shortcut: 2-finger swipe up
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Start Select to Speak with a 2-finger swipe up. If TalkBack is on, use a 3-finger swipe instead. You can also tap the **Accessibility** button. Tap an item, such as text or an image, to hear it. To hear everything, tap **Play**.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; steps paraphrased from the named section; excerpt quoted exactly

source_refs.title: Hear text read aloud - Chromebook Help
source_refs.applicability: Chromebook; ChromeVox reads the entire page
source_refs.verified_excerpt: When you press Ctrl + Alt + z, you can turn ChromeVox on or off from any page.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chromebook: Select the time at the bottom right, or press **Alt** + **Shift** + **s**. Select the **Settings** gear, then **Accessibility**. Under 'Text-to-Speech,' turn on **ChromeVox**. To turn ChromeVox on or off from any page, press **Ctrl** + **Alt** + **z**.
